title: Zevulun ben Dan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kiddushin 30a: Rav Yehudah said that Shmuel said, “Like Zevulun ben Dan, whose father’s father taught him Scripture, Mishnah and Talmud, halakhot and aggadot.” Rashi explains that he was a student in their days.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Kiddushin 30a paragraph fully writes Rav Yehudah reporting Shmuel and names Zevulun’s paternal grandfather as his teacher. This supports the contextual expansion of אר״י and the relationship direction. Rashi’s student gloss is Hyman’s report.

The complete Kiddushin 30a paragraph has Rav Yehudah reporting Shmuel and says Zevulun’s father’s father taught him. The two complete Rashi comments on Zevulun explicitly call him a student in their days and discuss teaching one’s son and grandson. These are textual attestations; they do not supply an additional genealogy or chronological identification.
